user_query: Please provide me with the most popular videos in the 'Music' category. Include details such as the video title, description, views, and duration. Additionally, give me information about the comments on these videos, including the comment text and the user who posted it.

TaskList.description: Fetch the list of the most popular videos in the 'Music' category.
Retrieve detailed information for each video including title, description, views, and duration.
Fetch comments for each of the popular videos obtained in the previous steps.
Compile and format all the retrieved information into a comprehensive summary.
